lens: Naming adherence — P10/P14 BNF kebab-case + version-suffix + filename rules
answer: PR #12 introduces three new names: (1) ADR file ADR-0117-repo-hygiene-gitignore-audit-config-and-kyverno-consolidation.md, (2) directory infra/kyverno/oya-vcs-admission/, (3) const ARGO_MANIFEST. All three pass the A1_naming_adherence lens (P10/P14 BNF kebab-case + ADR-NNNN convention + identifier-hygiene + naming-justification rule), with two MINOR observations and zero BLOCKER/MAJOR drift. ADR-0117 filename is fully kebab-case, uses the canonical ADR-NNNN-<slug>.md form, and at 86 characters its title slug is the longest in docs/decisions/ (next is ADR-0040 at 79; ADR-0098 at 75) but no length cap is specified in crate-naming-convention.md §1-§11 or in ADR-0017, so it is non-blocking. The slug accurately reflects both actions taken (gitignore-audit-config + kyverno-consolidation) which is consistent with the dual-action 'chore(hygiene)' commit. The directory token `oya-vcs-admission` carries the required `oya-` brand prefix (ADR-0017) and is consistent with the established `oya-foundry-vcs-*` crate family in /Users/jasonlee/oyatie/Cargo.toml (oya-vcs-kernel, oya-vcs-admission-gate-kernel, etc.), so its choice of `vcs` as a path token follows existing repo precedent. The crate-naming BNF v4.1 (slot-2 microservice closed enum) does NOT apply because this is a filesystem path under infra/kyverno/, not a Cargo crate name — the BNF binds only `oya-*` package names per §2 'crate ::= ...'. ADR-0117 carries an explicit '## Naming justification' section satisfying feedback_naming_justification (one-line proof of v4-BNF + 12-layer-enum non-impact since the move is path-only). ARGO_MANIFEST const is SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE per crate-naming-convention.md §10 (in-crate identifier hygiene). The four rewritten evidence-file paths inside oya-vcs-provider-execution-proof-1778845600.json are consistent — both old (deploy/gitops/oya-vcs-admission) and new (infra/kyverno/oya-vcs-admission) preserve the oya-vcs-admission leaf token, so no broader naming-scheme drift. Verdict: approve.

findings.summary: ADR-0117 filename slug is 86 characters — the longest in docs/decisions/ (vs ADR-0040 at 79, ADR-0098 at 75). It encodes two distinct actions ('gitignore-audit-config' + 'kyverno-consolidation') in one ADR. No length cap is documented, so non-blocking, but two single-action ADRs would each yield shorter, more discoverable slugs.
findings.recommended_action: Optional: in a future hygiene wave, prefer one-action-per-ADR to keep slugs ≤70 chars and improve `ls docs/decisions/ | grep` discoverability. No fix required for this PR.
